description.zh: 授权类型， 当前可选值为 ALL_USER_AUTHORIZATION 代表授权所有用户，SPECIFIC_USER_AUTHORIZATION 代表授权部分用户，UNAUTHORIZED 代表未授权
description.en:
The authorization type. Valid values:

- ALL_USER_AUTHORIZATION: all users are authorized.
- SPECIFIC_USER_AUTHORIZATION: specific users are authorized.
- UNAUTHORIZED: no users are authorized.

description.zh: 二维码类型，当前可以选值为 MINI_APP_BROWSER_TRANSACTION 代表支付宝小程序区块链浏览器。
description.en:
The QR code type. Valid values:

- MINI_APP_BROWSER_TRANSACTION: Alipay mini program blockchain browser.

title.zh: 设置蚂蚁区块链的交易二维码授权状态
title.en: Set ant blockchain transaction QR code authorization status
